capabilities: Edit catalog-driven STIX 2.1 object properties on notes
Import STIX 2.1 Bundles as typed, linked Markdown notes
Validate active notes and their connected graph against pinned local schemas
Visualize STIX JSON or connected notes as an interactive icon-based graph
Export collision-safe JSON Bundles from a note, folder, Canvas, or vault
extras: Desktop-only; mobile is not supported. Runs fully offline with no network calls or telemetry, and documents the Obsidian scorecard network warnings as an antlr4ng scanner false positive. A separate companion repository, CTI Investigation Vault, provides a starter vault with templates and the OASIS APT1 example.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to author, validate, visualize, or exchange structured STIX 2.1 cyber threat intelligence from notes without a hosted service.
summary: Local STIX 2.1 threat-intelligence workbench that turns wiki-linked investigation notes into validated, visualized, and exported STIX Bundles.
